text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro–body–conclusion structure","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is divided into distinct parts and closes with a wrap-up that restates the argument."},{"evidence":"\"three reasons\" and repeated point-by-point paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"It develops the position with multiple supporting reasons rather than staying at a brief, undeveloped claim."},{"evidence":"sensor example, safety example, cost example","quality":"supporting detail","description":"It backs the stance with several concrete details instead of relying mostly on general opinion."},{"evidence":"\"As i said in my introduction\" and \"So those are my three reasons\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses signposting and repetition to connect the parts of the essay and guide the reader."},{"evidence":"personal accident memory and safety concern","quality":"specific illustration","description":"It includes a personalized example that makes one of the reasons feel more grounded and vivid."}]}
